contentText: Some celebrities like Mark Ruffalo, Wanda Sykes and Natasha Lyonne donned anti-ICE pins at the Golden Globes on January 11 in tribute to Renee Good, who was shot and killed in her car by an Immigration and Customs Enforcement officer a few days earlier in Minneapolis. The ceremony crowned the success of the revolutionary comedy "One Battle After Another". FRANCE 24's Wassim Cornet tells us about what to expect from this year's awards season.
